'''G0-ON Attacker''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] model used by [[Nocturno]] and [[Drake Raven]], a pair of gladiators in the [[Arena Grand]] of [[Zakuul]]. Along with [[G0-ON Abductor]]s, these droids assisted them during the fights. In [[3630 BBY]] Nocturno and Drake were put up against a newcomer known as "[[Alliance Commander|the Mysterious Stranger]]," who defeated them along with their G0-ON Attackers in the seventh round of the Arena fights.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
G0-ON Attacker appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' as part of the seventh boss fight of the "Eternal Championship."<ref name="SWTOR" />
